name: breadcrumb
useFor: Use above a page head when a page sits deep in a hierarchy (Webhooks, then an endpoint, then a delivery). Fold middle levels into BreadcrumbEllipsis when the trail is long; use asChild to render your router's link.
constraints: A breadcrumb on a top-level page
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): page heads, muted text and links

examples.content:
import { LineVerticalIcon } from "@phosphor-icons/react/ssr";

import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from "@/components/ui/breadcrumb";

export function Preview() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Webhooks</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Delivery log</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>message.sent</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function Collapsed() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Agent Workspace</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbEllipsis />
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Tunnel</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Telemetry</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

export function CustomSeparator() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb>
      <BreadcrumbList>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#">Vault</BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator>
          <LineVerticalIcon className="rotate-12" />
        </BreadcrumbSeparator>
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbPage>Login credentials</BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  );
}

title: Breadcrumb
description: A trail of 14px muted links ending in the current page in ink, with faint carets between.
